items.title: Outdated emergency response plan during grid incident
items.description: A transmission operator's emergency response plan had not been updated for 3 years. During a major grid disturbance, responders followed outdated procedures that referenced decommissioned equipment, causing a 4-hour delay in restoration.
items.recommendation: Review and update emergency response plans annually. Test with tabletop exercises quarterly.

items.title: NERC CIP non-compliance resulted in $1.2M penalty
items.description: A utility failed to maintain electronic security perimeters around critical cyber assets. NERC audit found 47 violations of CIP standards across 8 substations. The $1.2M penalty was the largest that year.
items.recommendation: Conduct monthly CIP compliance self-assessments. Maintain current inventory of all critical cyber assets.

items.title: Emission monitoring gap triggered EPA enforcement
items.description: A power plant's continuous emission monitoring system (CEMS) had a 72-hour data gap due to a calibration failure. The gap was not reported within the required timeframe. EPA issued a Notice of Violation.
items.recommendation: Implement redundant CEMS monitoring. Establish automated alerts for data gaps exceeding 1 hour.

items.title: Deferred maintenance caused transformer failure and outage
items.description: Transformer oil analysis was deferred for 18 months due to budget constraints. The transformer failed during peak demand, causing a 36-hour outage affecting 45,000 customers.
items.recommendation: Never defer safety-critical maintenance. Transformer oil analysis should be performed on the original schedule regardless of budget pressure.
